VIII: 2nd Battalion, 7th Marines (Hanneken), made a forced march to the Metapona, about thirteen miles east of the Lunga, and by nightfall of 2 November had established defenses east of the river mouth near Tetere. About 2200 a Japanese force from the 230th Infantry began landing at Gavaga Creek, about one mile east of that position (already claimed on the Japanese side, C12841, dated 3 November).
